Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Foils don’t have to be your cup of tea, and that’s okay! Claim this bundle to receive the six non-foil drops in the August 2022 Superdrop and revel in their non-reflective finish. They’re especially handy to have in your collection or deck if you’re the kind of being that’s sensitive to chromatic shimmering, like an alternate-universe superbee. In that case, please disregard any notes on a hypothetical human rebellion against the superbees, because we’re definitely kidding about it, ha ha. Now back to harvesting honey in the Detention Comb of Superhive Alpha 272, nothing to see here.

Contents:
• 1x Artist Series: Nils Hamm
• 1x Artist Series: Victor Adame Minguez
• 1x Dan Frazier Is Back Again: The Allied Talismans
• 1x Dan Frazier Is Back Again: The Enemy Talismans
• 1x Imaginary Friends
• 1x In Memoriam: Jaya Ballard
